column2: You lose if any one of the Liches leaves the battlefield
column3: Outdated in part (conclusion B): written 2004-10-04 (Gatherer's first batch of rulings; its "battlefield" wording is a later rewording that kept the date) for the Oracle text "When Lich leaves play, you lose the game" (Latest Oracle Update, Paul Barclay, 2002-03-14), "leaves the battlefield" from Magic 2010 (Magic 2010 Rules Changes, 2009-06-10: a terminology swap only). The September 2010 Update Bulletin (Matt Tabak, 2010-09-22; Oracle update announced to go live 2010-09-24) changed it to "When Lich is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, you lose the game" ("the printed card says you lose when Lich is destroyed, but that was broadened to Lich leaving the battlefield"), today's text but for "this enchantment", so a Lich that leaves the battlefield for another zone doesn't trigger it (tested in tests/rulings/r_p096_lich.rs, lich_leaving_the_battlefield_except_to_a_graveyard_doesnt_trigger_its_last_ability, and for its owner leaving the game in an_opponent_stealing_lich_makes_you_lose_but_doesnt_change_their_life). "Any one of the Liches" still holds for a Lich put into a graveyard, and the rest of the ruling still holds; both are tested, and the rest is cited, in tests/rulings/r_p096_lich.rs

column2: greater than 0 at the time the Lich leaves the battlefield
column3: Outdated in part (conclusion B): the 2010-08-15 version of this ruling (the Gatherer date of the Magic 2011 rulings), written for the Oracle text "When Lich leaves the battlefield, you lose the game". The September 2010 Update Bulletin (Matt Tabak, 2010-09-22; Oracle update announced to go live 2010-09-24) changed the last ability to "When Lich is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, you lose the game", and on 2011-01-01 Wizards reworded the ruling to "at the time the Lich is put into the graveyard", its only change (the date of the Gatherer rulings for that bulletin's other changes: Transmute Artifact, Word of Command, Voodoo Doll and the new life-exchange rule). The rewrite, and the parts the two versions share (another effect preventing the loss for 0 life; Platinum Angel), are cited in tests/rulings/r_p096_lich.rs
